What prediction product can Vedaansh ship from Tattva notes?

Long image

A

Answer

Ship a Tattva Prediction Layer: chart → four trikonas → dasha flavor → safety-gated remedies. Most of the teaching text already lives in Rashi and Lagna modules; the gap is chart-conditioned synthesis wired into Dasha and analysis panels.

  1. Reuse rashiInterpretations, lagnaSpirituality, modality counts in Dig/Drig, and Vimshottari period analysis — do not rebuild sign encyclopedias.1234
  2. New value is predictive: Agni initiation type, Artha money type, Vayu network load, Moksha stress, plus Active/Reactive dasha spice.
  3. Gate hard claims as educational; Moon MD/AD should suppress firm event predictions (session rule).
  4. Gold unlocks full synthesis; Free keeps trikona map teaser; Platinum can add client CRM remedy packs.

Applies toVedaansh product planTattva + Dasha predictioneducational only

  1. Trikona Map ↗

    Score planet density and lords in 1-5-9, 2-6-10, 3-7-11, 4-8-12; headline which element runs the life.

  2. Agni Initiation ↗

    Classify how the native starts things: Aries survival bursts, Leo sustain, Dhanu purpose/parampara.

  3. Artha Money Types ↗

    Tag wealth as 2nd (lineage stock), 6th (daily grind), 10th (peak karma) from house load + dasha.

  4. Vayu Network ↗

    Flag 3-7-11 concentration for speech, partners, audiences; Rahu amplifies outsider reach.

  5. Moksha Stress ↗

    Soft-read 4-8-12; warn that over-activating 8 can hit 4 (home/heart).

  6. Active vs Reactive ↗

    Tag current MD/AD sign as initiative vs reaction — masala only, never sole verdict.

  7. Moon Forecast Gate ↗

    In Moon MD/AD, hide firm event cards; show sadhana guidance instead.

  8. Life Stability Score ↗

    Count planets in Chara / Sthira / Dual on D1 and D10; reuse Dig modality notes.

  9. Remedy Protocol ↗

    Combine house + karaka + rashi; Moon→Dvaita discourse, Ketu→Advaita/jnana, Sun→dharma/sacrifice.

  10. Chart + Dasha Panels ↗

    New tab or section under Interpretation / Dasha More; Gold full, Free teaser.

How should the prediction pipeline run?

Diagram structure

  1. ChartOutput ↗

    Needs grahas, lagna, vimshottari nodes, optional D10.

  2. Trikona scores ↗

    Element load + dominant sign flavor per trikona.

  3. Dasha flavor ↗

    Active/Reactive tag + planet nature alignment check.

  4. Moon period? ↗

    If Moon is MD or AD, suppress firm event forecasts.

  5. Soft guidance only ↗

    Discourse / sadhana cards; no date-stamped life events.

  6. Full prediction pack ↗

    Area activations + flavor + multi-house simultaneous read.

  7. Remedy cards ↗

    House × karaka × rashi; never Moon remedies inside Ketu dasha.

Session rules that must ship as product constraints

Odd/even is Active vs Reactive, not profit/loss — label it as spice. Do not recommend Moon remedies during Ketu dasha. Stay educational: health chains (Ketu→gut→etc.) need soft caution, not diagnosis. Astrologer UX: optional “stay neutral” reminder when viewing Rahu/Scorpio drama on client charts.
